<div class="page-heading"><div class="eyebrow">Research in practice</div><h1>Projects &amp; impact</h1><p class="lede">Connecting research, students and partners around challenging real-world, interdisciplinary problems.</p></div><section class="section" id=""><h2>Data Challenges &amp; hackathons</h2><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2026</div><h3>Natixis CIB — Data Challenge</h3><p>Financial anomaly analysis, domain-specific data and a conversational assistant: integrating AI, interpretation and operational needs.</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2025</div><h3>Covéa — Data Challenge</h3><p>Develop a financial-health indicator to anticipate insurance-contract profitability despite imbalanced data, missing values and interpretability requirements.</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2024</div><h3>Safran — Data Challenge</h3><p>Industry-facing data science challenge with Safran. The detailed task and deliverables will be added from cleared source materials.</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2023</div><h3>Natixis — NLP &amp; central bank speeches</h3><p>Analyze central-bank speeches and their relationship with financial-market movements; build and assess out-of-sample trading strategies using textual signals.</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2022</div><h3>Natixis — Data Challenge</h3><p>Earlier Data Challenge collaboration involving economic speeches and market data.</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2025</div><h3>DIRISI — Cybersécurité et anomalies</h3><p>Three-day hackathon, 18–20 November 2025: detect and characterize incidents using firewall data; distinguish faults from attacks, assess severity, propose countermeasures, and deliver a robust operator interface.</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">2024</div><h3>DIRISI — Prévision de charge des réseaux</h3><p>A separate hackathon on historical IT-system workload analysis and peak prediction to support resource planning for military networks.
